notes.title: Patch 03 - Bug Fixes and Minor Mission Changes
notes.content: We fixed the broken Key Mapping System. Special thanks to the community for helping find this bug. All changes to the key map will now work and be saved. We are working on adding controller support, should be in an upcoming patch. Also we are working on making the missions easier to play. In this patch we changed how the mission starts by reducing the number of enemy bots and recommending using the Bayonet Shield to get out of the hangar. We really appreciate all the feedback and bug reports we get from the gaming community. Since we are just 2 devs working on the game, its really hard to find all the bugs, Thanks! -LtF

tags.bug: We fixed the broken Key Mapping System.

notes.title: MAJOR DEVELOPMENT UPDATE - Multiplayer and SinglePlayer Released!
notes.content:
After 10 years of work..........
We finally got the full version of strategy FPS/RTS posted for the public!!!
We had no idea that it would take this long to complete.  Making games using the Unreal engine is almost impossible, and this game is 100x more complex than most.  There is so much in the game it would be impossible to explain here. This release is the first Beta of Bionite. It has all but just a few of the  features that will be available in the final release.  The full command system is ready for you guys to check out. For example: the tanks have the following commands: Follow, Hold, Go To Location, Go To Navigation Beacon, Attack, Hunt, Patrol, Fly in Formation, Protect, and Reassign to a new player or squad.
The single player missions introduce the alien race and contain tool tips to help people learn the complex command system. The missions explain what Bioore and Spectralite are and how to use them. We are going to keep the game in early access for a few more weeks while we finish the new trailer. Once the trailer is done, were going to release an update then move the game to Final Release. Hotshot and I super appreciate all the support from our community and the extreme patients that you guys have had. I wish we could have done this faster, but making a [i]stable[/i] game of this complexity is EXTREMELY difficult to do. More announcements to come shortly......~LtF

notes.title: Were Finally Getting Ready to Release an Update
notes.content:
Sorry about the delay updating the game, but we had alot of work to do and even more testing.  By the end of this month we will have a major overhaul posted with more bug fixes than i can list and a new map.  We have spent hundreds of hours getting this new update done. Some of the improvements:

No more fixed camera, we moved it to a rotating one that is much smoother and easier to aim.

Better Vehicle handling and maneuvering using better physics.

Bug fixes for the AI that werent quit working as good as they should. The slow extractor for example, is fixed.

The new interior for the Bayonet, the Longbow, and Rhino.  

The new map for Mars is a trainer with tool tips but focuses more on engaging the enemy in battle.

New Patrol State for the wingmen.  Now you can set nav beacons around your base and tell your wingmen to Patrol using those beacons as waypoints.

The preliminary character mesh with the sniper rifle and the jetpack might be in this release. It might have to wait until the next one if I cant get it working right.

The Water Mine Mission on Europa will be done at the end of May and the Pit Mine Mission at the end of June. Once the first four singleplayer maps are done, were going to move to full release. 

Immediately after full release were going to start testing MP and continue to add maps and new content.  Thanks to everyone that has supported our mission of bringing this game to life, were working on hella more content and new maps right now.

I did a quick shadowplay video of one of the Actors in the upcoming mission on mars. Part of this mission is to stop the Bomb Truck from entering the Protien Farm Dome. If it gets in there, this is what happens... 

https://youtu.be/N5XOvmj0ovs

notes.title: New WingCard for Recent Update Posted
notes.content:
The New Wing Card for the Recent Update has been posted to Steam. This has all the new functions and key maps for the new SinglePlayer Update. We are revising the manual now, its taking some time (damn thing is near 50 pages!).
Check our store page under Quick Ref for WingCard Rev 15. It is also available on our website under the 'How to Play' section. 

If you are new to Bionite and havnt played Battlezone before, you might be confused by the Tool Tip #2. When selecting the wingmen in Squad One, it is the F5 key that opens the comm channel to the pilot(s).
We are working on an update now for the game that will serve as a hotfix for a couple of bugs we found since the release. 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1149302837
